name: Spike - does plain CSP render rain without PURE or Sol
notes: The 'none' weather system option rests on this. Three separate things draw weather in CSP and only the middle one belongs to a mod: RainFX is core CSP and owns the drops, puddles, car wetness and spray; the weather IMPLEMENTATION draws sky, clouds and lighting, and its 'base' is by CSP's own author and ships a rain haze shader plus rain audio; the CONTROLLER only decides the numbers, and base/controller.lua sets rainIntensity unconditionally from a per-type table. All of that is read rather than driven, and source-reading has already been wrong twice on this mod stack, so drive it. This race names the base controller and asks for CSP weather type 7, Rain. WHAT TO LOOK FOR, most important first: is there water on the road and does the car get visibly wet; are there drops on the screen and spray off the car ahead; is the sky merely grey or properly overcast. Expect the rain to be LIGHTER than the same race under PURE - base uses CSP's hardcoded 0.1 for Rain while our career_rain preset asks for 0.125, and base does not read [RAINFX] at all. That difference is expected, not a bug. If it rains, 'none' is a real option and the settings copy can say so. If it does not, 'none' means dry races and every wet weather type has to be hidden under it, which is a different UI.
